stories.title: Police use drone to locate knife-wielding suspect in Chinatown
stories.summary: Honolulu police used a drone to locate a man who was waving a knife in Chinatown before officers took him into custody.

stories.title: NTSB: Improper maintenance led to deadly 2024 Kamaka Air crash
stories.summary: The NTSB says a flap-system failure and maintenance problems led to the 2024 crash that killed two pilots near Honolulu’s airport.

stories.title: First Alert Forecast: Windy, wet weekend ahead

stories.title: Family to honor Marlon ‘Uncle Malone’ Ramones after fatal moped crash
stories.summary: The family of 62-year-old Marlon “Uncle Malone” Ramones, who died after being hit on his moped on Oct. 26, is planning to honor his life.

stories.title: Transgender Day of Remembrance honors lives lost to violence
stories.summary: Nov. 20 commemorates Transgender Day of Remembrance

stories.title: Father challenges league transfer rule that sidelined Maui athlete
stories.summary: A move meant a new school for 16-year-old Jai Carbonell — and a year away from sports. His family is challenging the league rule behind that decision.

stories.title: ‘A bad mistake’: Former police commission chair apologizes for agenda error
stories.summary: She said stepping down was the best wait to maintain public trust in the commission.

stories.title: DLNR warns of scam seeking payments for water use permits
stories.summary: Applicants should not reply and should not click on any suspicious payment links, send electronic payments or provide financial information.

stories.title: Electronic waste recycling resuming in Molokai
stories.summary: Electronic waste (e-waste) recycling services will resume at Recycle Molokaʻi starting Tuesday, Dec. 1, the County of Maui Department of Environmental Management announced.

stories.title: Kamehameha, Kapolei set for Open Division championship
stories.summary: Kamehameha returns to the Open Division title game against Kapolei, which is seeking its first state football championship.

stories.title: EPA investigating fuel spill at Honolulu’s H-POWER plant
stories.summary: Federal investigators are examining the H-POWER fuel spill as records reveal earlier leaks and officials assess the extent of contamination.

stories.title: Hawaii marching band students to perform in 100th Macy’s Thanksgiving Day Parade
stories.summary: 17 public schools will be represented at the parade.
